{{Quote|We've caught up with the Imp butchers. Let's show them just how dangerous Mon Calamari Rangers are.|[[Krakana/Legends|Krakana]] Leader|<ref name="Legacy (2006) 32">[[Legacy (2006) 32|''Legacy'' (2006) 32]]</ref>}}
The '''Mon Calamari Rangers''' were a resistance organization active on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in [[137 ABY]]. The Rangers' goal was the protection of [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] refugees and opposing the [[Genocide on Dac|genocide]] of their people that began with the [[Massacre of New Coral City]].

==History==
Before [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi|Stazi's]] capture of the [[Alliance (Imperious-class)|''Imperious'']], the [[Mon Calamari Council]] took precautions in case that they would suffer for the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] theft. However, their preparations were cut short when [[Darth Krayt]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic]] [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Emperor]], ordered the [[Genocide on Dac|extermination]] of 10% of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] population as an example to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Joined up with [[Imperial Knight]] [[Treis Sinde]], the Mon Calamari Rangers sought to protect their people until the Empire could be driven off planet. With his guidance, the Rangers faced the [[Sea Leviathan]] during the [[Battle of Devil's Crevasse]]. After Master Sinde returned to [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], he was replaced by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Asaak Dan]].

In preparation for [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuation]] of the planet's civilian population orchestrated by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], the Rangers, with the aid of Master Dan seized the floating city of [[Heurkea Floating City|Heurkea]], facing a small garrison of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the process.
